newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas Gas extends notes tender offer.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas Gas extends notes tender offer.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp said Thursday that it is extending an offer to purchase its outstanding $800 million issue of 11.5 percent senior secured notes due 2002.
The company said the new expiration is 0930 EDT (1330 GMT) on June 13.

TransTexas said it will also extend the expiration of its offer to buy outstanding 13.25 percent series A senior subordinated notes due 2003 until 0930 EDT (1330 GMT) on June 18. The exchange rate of the offer has been increased to $612.89 per $1,000 face value from $594.00 per $1,000, it said.

TransAmerican Energy Corp, the parent of TransTexas Gas, said it is extending its tender offer for all outstanding warrants to purchase common shares of its TransAmerican Refining Corp unit to 0930 EDT on June 13.
